ext.description: AI coding assistant for VS Code. Bring your own key or use a local runtime.
config.title: Xratu
config.mcpServers.desc:
Legacy fallback for **MCP servers** - configure them in the Xratu panel's dedicated **MCP page** instead (files: global `mcp.json` / workspace `.xratu/mcp.json`). This setting is only read when both files are empty.

Their tools are exposed to the agent as `mcp__<server>__<tool>` and require your approval unless auto-approved on the MCP page.
config.webSearchProvider.desc: Web-search provider for local mode's web_search tool. Auto uses SearXNG when a search URL is set, otherwise Brave.
config.webSearchUrl.desc: SearXNG instance base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8888) used by local mode's web_search tool.
config.webSearchApiKey.desc: Brave Search API key used by local mode's web_search tool.
config.proxyUrl.desc: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for model and web requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Overrides VS Code's http.proxy setting and the HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY environment variables. SOCKS proxies are not supported yet.
config.noProxy.desc: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy (e.g. localhost,127.0.0.1,.internal). Overrides VS Code's http.noProxy setting and the NO_PROXY environment variable. Supports * and host:port entries; CIDR ranges are not supported.
config.modelPricing.desc: Per-model price overrides per 1M tokens, keyed by model id, e.g. { "my-model": { "input": 0.5, "output": 1.5, "cachedInput": 0.05, "currency": "IRT" } }. Currency defaults to USD. Wins over the built-in price table.
config.providerPricing.desc: Per-provider gateway rates, keyed by base-URL host, e.g. { "api.avalai.ir": { "tomanPerUsd": 90000, "markupPercent": 10 } }. Toman costs for that host are the USD price table multiplied by this rate. Iranian providers fall back to xratu.tomanPerUsd when no host rate is set.
config.tomanPerUsd.desc: Fallback Toman per USD, used only when a provider host has no rate in xratu.providerPricing. 0 = no fallback (Toman costs then show only for providers with a host rate or a model override).
